read-only Zenodo REST inspection of record 6640513 and latest successor 6824749
download and pdftotext only the two small official release descriptions; no mock archive download

findings.statement: Howlett et al. describe 256 l-picola boxes with eight observers each and the official mock description identifies 2,048 catalogue files plus released row-level sky, redshift, halo, velocity, selection-photometry, true/observed FP, and uncorrected fitted distance-ratio columns. The release supports a newly frozen mock-based observational depth-feature extraction and common-replicate covariance calculation, with mock and box IDs retained.
assumptions_used: Zenodo v1.1.0 is the intended public successor of v1.0.0.
A depth extraction will retain mock/box identity and will not assume same-box observer catalogues are iid.
reproduction: Verify the Zenodo latest-record metadata reports mocks.tar.gz MD5 9ba3e8876f6f08a2af00d30cbf1c6cd9.
Read mock_description.pdf and map each stated column to a frozen feature extractor before opening mock members.
unresolved: The source calls the catalogues non-overlapping but same-box observer catalogues share a simulation volume; the release evidence does not establish an iid interpretation.
The parent implementation must retain box/mock identifiers and specify any cluster-aware uncertainty treatment.

findings.statement: Released mock distance fields are logdist/logdist_err/logdist_alpha from a single FP fit. The preferred public-data fields are logdist_corr/logdist_corr_err/logdist_corr_alpha from FP fits split by Tempel group richness, with a group-level CF3 zero-point calibration. The mock description supplies neither group-richness nor corrected distance fields, and provides no released state--jet variables, anchor, response, prospective allocation, or jointly calibrated coverage event. Thus the release does not establish a complete common state-jet-anchor confidence law.
assumptions_used: Parent analysis distinguishes the data single-FP lane from the preferred group-richness-corrected lane.
A physical confidence image requires the joint coverage conditions specified in the assigned R9 model-to-data contract.
reproduction: Compare the data-description definitions of logdist and logdist_corr with the mock-description distance fields.
Use paper §5.3 and §5.4 to confirm group-richness refitting and group-level zero-point calibration.
Before analysis, choose the uncorrected single-FP data lane with its non-preferred limitation or obtain/calibrate an equivalently corrected mock law; neither supplies state-jet-anchor joint coverage.
unresolved: No released pre-selection parent, visual/reject decision ledger, Tempel group mapping/richness, CF3 cross-match/calibration draw, exact fitting code/configuration/seeds, or intermediate selection record was identified.

No release-complete law exists for the final depth-bin target, its mask/row policy, nuisance/calibration handling, covariance estimator, state--jet coupling, anchor, or full-identified-set coverage procedure.
The allowed analysis did not download or inspect the large mock archive; row descriptions are source evidence, not acquired-data validation.

claim_results.summary: Mapped released mock processing and fields, then identified the single-FP mock versus preferred group-richness-corrected data mismatch and the absence of a common state-jet-anchor coverage law.

limitations: Read-only primary-source mapping only; no large mock archive was downloaded, no product execution occurred, and no scientific admission or claim promotion was performed.

The default-cwd start/stop hooks point to a different legacy checkout/run. The actual-worktree assignment was read and the result was written at its registered path, but no authenticated native launch/profile PASS is available.
No transfer result was evaluated; this result makes no transfer-conditional label or conclusion.
